results.description:
KeepThis makes it fast to send links to the right place.                                                                           
                                                                                                                                    
 Create simple email targets like Food, Music, Reading, Ideas, or Work. Each target has a recipient email address and subject       
 prefix. When you find a link you want to keep, use the iOS Share Sheet, choose KeepThis, pick a target, and KeepThis opens a       
 pre-filled Apple Mail draft.                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                    
 Review it, tap Send, and you’re done.                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                    
 Features:                                                                                                                          
 • Create multiple local email targets                                                                                              
 • Share links from Safari, Instagram, and other apps                                                                               
 • Extract URLs from shared links or text containing a link                                                                         
 • Choose one target per send                                                                                                       
 • Open a pre-filled Apple Mail draft                                                                                               
 • Edit or delete targets anytime                                                                                                   
 • No accounts, backend, analytics, or tracking                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                    
 Private by design:                                                                                                                 
 KeepThis stores your targets locally on your device. Shared links are passed directly into Apple Mail’s compose screen. KeepThis   
 does not collect, transmit, track, analyze, or sell your data.                                                                     
                                                                                                                                    
 Note: KeepThis uses Apple Mail to send messages, so Mail must be configured on your device.
